en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.940 - Mansur ibn Yunus Buzurj asked Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) about a person who strives to cry during the obligatory prayer until tears flow.
Imam (as) replied: "It is a source of great joy, by Allah (swt)."
The Imam also said: "When this happens, remember me in that moment”.
